The ticket for the Eastbank receiving-door import at Marrow Agrisupply is **PD-4821**. I've posted that in a thread reply to you in #inc-tansley-carrier-api.

It comes from your own message in #central-team on 9 June. That message also said the import file labels the doors E1/E2 while their booking sheet uses 01/02. That mismatch needed fixing before anyone reimports, or the reimport would create duplicates. I haven't seen anything since saying it was fixed.
